studies.TITLE: Interval calibration of the published range (past-only conformal)
studies.HYPOTHESIS: The backtest coverage of the published range is optimistic because its residual bank includes each film's own and later residuals; a past-only bank lowers coverage below 68%, and past-only split conformal on log residuals (pooled C1 or Mondrian by horizon C2) restores latest-per-film coverage to a 95% CI containing 68% without worsening log interval score
studies.PRIMARY_METRIC: Primary: range coverage latest-per-film and per horizon (target 68%); secondary: log interval score, width, aLoss r=2 of the point, under/over 60M; paired film bootstrap 10000, Holm across C1,C2 vs P0
studies.DECISION_RULE: Optimism confirmed if P0 miss minus BASE miss CI excludes 0 (latest). Shadow-candidate for the C arm whose latest coverage 95% CI contains 68% while P0's lies below 68%, with iscore vs P0 not worse (CI spans 0 or below) and no horizon/size subgroup iscore worse with CI excluding 0; prefer C1 if both. Else no-change if P0 already ~68%, otherwise inconclusive
studies.RESULT: Optimism confirmed; no calibration arm qualifies. 101 films (temporal blocks 3-8), latest per film. Coverage of published range: BASE (pooled bank, as backtest) 66.3% [57.4,75.2]; P0 (past-only bank, as live) 57.4% [47.5,67.3]; P0 miss minus BASE +0.089 [95% CI +0.040,+0.149], worse at every horizon; aLoss and iscore tie. C1 past-only split conformal 56.4% [46.5,66.3]; C2 Mondrian by horizon 54.5% [44.6,64.4]: neither CI contains 68%, so rule 2 fails. Past-only q16/q84 under-cover => errors grow over time (non-exchangeable). Conformal iscore worse <60M (C1 +0.245 [+0.135,+0.350], n=82) and better >=60M (-0.452 [-0.842,-0.068], n=19): error scale depends on size. Point aLoss unchanged by construction. Same-day V7 recipe: 135 films (registered 134), MAPE 0.393, aLoss 0.524, within tolerance; reproduces() False on film count only. Next: adaptive/recency-weighted conformal, Mondrian by predicted size tier.

studies.TITLE: IP framework v1 relabel (Mike-approved candidate 2026-10-21)
studies.HYPOTHESIS: Relabeling KNOWN_IP_TIER by the written framework (brand-strength 0-3, Mike's spin-off and public-domain rules) and filling missing page-verified predecessors lowers V7-recipe aLoss(r=2) on the temporal holdout versus V7 retrained same-day on current labels.
studies.PRIMARY_METRIC: aLoss r=2, paired film bootstrap on the temporal holdout (latest-per-film and d-21/14/7/3), MAPE and median APE secondary; per-IP-tier error before/after
studies.DECISION_RULE: Adopt-candidate only if paired aLoss diff 95% CI excludes 0 in favour of the arm on latest-per-film AND no horizon or size subgroup (<60M/>=60M) worsens with CI excluding 0; Holm across 2 arms. Otherwise tie/reject. Holdout reused, so any win is provisional pending shadow.
studies.RESULT: Tie. Same-day V7 recipe, 135 holdout films, latest per film: aLoss BASE 0.532; A (tiers) 0.517, diff -0.015 [95% CI -0.038, +0.007], Holm p 0.18; B (tiers + 2 verified predecessors) 0.513, diff -0.019 [-0.042, +0.002], Holm p 0.16. No horizon/subgroup better; A worse for >=60M at d-21 (+0.050 [+0.003, +0.099]) and d-14 (+0.054 [+0.009, +0.101]). The model sees IP only via PCTILE_X_IP_HIGH and PCTILE_X_PREDOW, so relabeling moves little. Labels are cleaner (tier-3 OW range 23-360M vs 5.8-360M) but 43 overrides were set with outcomes visible, so the backtest is optimistic. Recommend: adopt labels as data hygiene only after Mike reviews changes and Lomis page-verifies 17 suspect predecessors; no model change.

studies.TITLE: Live vs backtest accuracy gap (graded films)
studies.HYPOTHESIS: The live gap (median APE 52%, coverage 6/16) is explained mainly by input defects fixed in V7 and horizon/size mix plus sampling noise, not by model error beyond the backtest distribution
studies.PRIMARY_METRIC: coverage of published range; median APE; aLoss r=2 (primary); mean MAPE separately; log bias
studies.DECISION_RULE: Input-defect explanation holds if V5_CORR restores coverage to within the binomial 95% CI of the mix-matched backtest coverage; intervals miscalibrated if V7_CORR coverage is below the mix-matched backtest coverage at p<0.05; otherwise inconclusive at n=16, re-check at n>=30
studies.RESULT: Live REC coverage 7/16 (95% CI 20-70%) vs mix-matched backtest 63.5%, p=0.12; median APE 52% at 99th pctile of BT. Pre-registered V5_CORR 11/16 and V7_CORR 14/16 are in-sample (14/16 and 16/16 films in training), so the rule cannot be applied. Unregistered out-of-fold arm on corrected inputs: 6/16 (CI 15-65%), p=0.038 below BT; OOF-REC aLoss -0.06 [-0.28,+0.14] tie. n=16 of 19 graded.
